venue.name: Craigflower Manor and School House – National Historic Sites of Canada
venue.description: Craigflower Manor is a pre-confederation farmhouse built for the McKenzie family between 1853 and 1856 by the Puget's Sound Agricultural Company, a subsidiary of the Hudson's Bay Company, and is one of the oldest remaining farmhouses in British Columbia. It stands on a grassy knoll overlooking Craigflower Bridge and the Gorge Waterway, restored in the 1960s and furnished as Mrs. McKenzie might have liked it in the 1860s, with a number of original McKenzie items still in the home. The Manor is operated as a historic house museum by the Victoria Highland Games Association, which offers 45-minute tours by reservation with admission by donation. The neighbouring Craigflower Schoolhouse is held by the Hallmark Heritage Society, whose website publishes historical articles about the building but no visiting hours, admission or booking information.
venue.address: 110 Island Highway, View Royal, Victoria, British Columbia
venue.hours_notes: Tours by reservation. The published schedule lists Saturday, May 31st, Saturday, June 7th, Saturday, June 14th and Saturday, June 21st at 12 pm, 1 pm and 2 pm, with tours running 45 minutes.

programs.name: Guided tour of Craigflower Manor
programs.description: A 45-minute tour of the Manor, booked in advance by email to the Victoria Highland Games Association with your name, desired time and how many will be attending. Admission is by donation. The tour dates published on the operator's page are Saturdays in May and June 2025 at 12 pm, 1 pm and 2 pm, so current dates need confirming.
programs.what_children_do: Walk through the restored rooms of an 1850s farmhouse furnished as the McKenzie family would have had it in the 1860s, including some of the family's original belongings.
programs.our_note: The only schedule on the operator's page is a short run of Saturdays in May and June 2025, so email before you plan anything and ask whether weekday visits for groups are possible. Nothing on the site addresses children's groups, so treat the age range, group size and washroom question as open.
programs.practical_summary: A 45-minute tour by advance email reservation with admission by donation. Nothing is published about washrooms, lunch space, accessibility, parking or group sizes.
programs.extra_fees_note: Admission by donation - no set price is published.
